description: This file contains a Python source code string for sandbox file system mutation operations, such as creating, removing, renaming, and writing files in a sandboxed environment, exposed as a constant string in a TypeScript module.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Open a directory with specific flags.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Navigate to a parent directory, optionally creating missing directories.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Create a temporary file within a directory.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Generate a filesystem path from a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Execute a subprocess command with specified file descriptors.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Write data from standard input to a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Handle writing data to a file within the sandboxed environment.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Create nested directories in the sandbox.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Remove a file or directory in the sandbox.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Rename or move a file within the sandbox.
